children: Calidi Biotherapeutics entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement to raise capital through a registered direct offering. The company sold 1,025,640 shares of common stock at $1.17 per share, generating approximately $1.2 million in gross proceeds. The offering closed on September 21, 2026, with no underwriter or placement agent involved, and proceeds will support working capital and general corporate purposes. The company agreed to a 45-day issuance restriction, and directors and executives are subject to a 60-day lock-up.
